title: Maximum liability.
bodyText: Notwithstanding any other provision, the liability of the contractors recovery fund shall not exceed $25,000 for any licensed contractor.
bodyHtml: §444-34  Maximum liability.  Notwithstanding any other provision, the liability of the contractors recovery fund shall not exceed $25,000 for any licensed contractor. [L 1973, c 170, pt of §1; am L 1975, c 183, §2; am L 1983, c 201, §6]
